title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 08:39:42 最新章节：第1789章 突然发现的坑洞
content_zh:
星越皇朝xxxx年x月xx日，天气晴
今天是来到这个地方的第365天，刚好满一年，作为一个走上社会的社畜，想了想，还是按照以前的习惯写一个年终总结，当作是一个记录，毕竟正经人谁写日记啊，对吧。
但没说不可以写总结，嘿嘿，看吧，我就是这么正经。
一年前的今天，当我眼睛睁开之时，便发现自己躺在一个大床上，但很明显，不是家里卧室的席梦思，而房顶也不是卧室里的极简装修风，直到我坐起来后，才发现我居然躺在一个40平米的有着古代装修风格的房间里，房间墙壁看起来是用豪华的木材搭建的建筑，整个房间内弥漫着淡淡的香味，不知道是啥，但闻起来挺舒服的。
看着眼前的景象，我整个人都有点懵逼，脑袋浑浑噩噩，不禁发出灵魂三问。
我是谁？我在哪？我在干什么？
此时，旁边一个女声传来，只见她惊喜的说道，“非凡少爷，您终于醒了，老爷和夫人知道了一定很高兴的。”
非凡少爷？谁啊，我吗？什么情况？
用手撑着脑袋想了好半天，只记得我作为一个卑微社畜加了一天班回家后就躺床上了，人困得不行，想着赶紧休息会，怎么一睁眼就变成这样了，赶紧拍了拍脸，有点疼，说明不是做梦，反而有点像是穿越。
Em……但是感觉这穿越似乎也穿越的非常随便啊，我既没有被车撞，也没有被雷劈，更不是在电脑中点了某些神秘的选项，就是加班累了，回家睡了个觉而已，这也能穿越？
卧槽！！！难道是睡觉的时候因为过劳挂了？不是吧，阿SIR，没听说啊，睡觉中也能过劳挂的，这也太离谱了吧
就在我胡思乱想的时候，旁边的女声继续说道，“非凡少爷，您现在刚醒过来，感觉身体还有什么不舒服的地方吗？“
听见这问题我下意识的回答道。
“额，还好，没有感觉什么不对劲的地方，可能刚睡醒，就头还有点晕吧“
“我知道了，那小芳现在去通知老爷和夫人，他们在城里的家族集市中工作，可能要花点时间，您先在房里稍等一会，桌上有点心，如果非凡少爷感觉饿了，可以吃一点垫垫肚子。“
说完，就急匆匆的退出了房间，只留下我在这里持续懵逼。
趁此机会，我稍微整理了下已经得到的信息，首先我现在叫非凡，别说，这名字听起来就不一般，有前途，不过居然姓非，这倒是个挺少见的姓，可惜不是穿越后的大姓，这一点就开局不利。
还有我是个少爷，说明家底应该是不错，刚刚那个叫小芳的应该是侍女吧？说去通知我父母了，那说明我父母健在，没有加入孤儿院系列。
em……这点倒是不知道是好是坏，从上辈子的网络小说中可以得出经验，一般穿越后无父无母的，后续都有大成就，少说仙王起步，混的好一点的，那都是什么大帝打底啊，一世横推，天下无敌。
啧啧啧，按照这样推算的话，我这开局简直就是hard难度，哎，真难顶，而且身为穿越过来的人，毕竟都这么大了，心智已经成熟，很难和新的父母产生亲情，如何处理和父母的关系也是个问题，不知道会不会影响以后的道心。

话说这里到底是高武还是低武世界也不知道，这个道心问题好像没那么重要？
不仅如此，现在脑中完全没有这个叫非凡的人之前的任何记忆，毫无头绪，等会怎么和父母交流也是个大问题，看来只能装失忆了。
果然，以前看小说时就觉得穿越后开局失忆很老套，但现在看起来似乎只有这个办法了，毕竟两眼一抹黑，不这样难道直接说我是另一个世界的人？大能转世？那估摸着活不过5分钟。
没有烂套路，只有合适的套路。
后来，这具身体的原父母来了后，我就直接装了下失忆，居然没有引起怀疑，这让我一开始很紧张的心情稍微放松了下来，从他们的口中得知这身体叫叶非凡。（原来姓叶啊，早说啊，一听这姓就知道能成大事，穿越后四大家族之一，虽然我有了父母，但是好在没有脱离套路，逐渐回到了熟悉的开局。）
content_en:
Xingyue Dynasty xxxx year x month xx day, the weather is fine
Today is the 365th day since I came to this place, which is exactly one year. As a social worker who has entered the society, I thought about it and wrote a year-end summary according to my previous habit as a record. After all, who is a serious person who writes a diary, right?
But I didn’t say you can’t write a summary. Hey, look, I’m just so serious.
One year ago today, when I opened my eyes, I found myself lying on a big bed, but it was obviously not the Simmons in the bedroom at home, and the roof was not the minimalist decoration style in the bedroom. It wasn't until I sat up that I realized that I was lying in a 40-square-meter room with ancient decoration style. The walls of the room looked like they were made of luxurious wood. The whole room was filled with a faint fragrance. I don't know what it was, but it smelled quite comfortable.
Looking at the scene in front of me, I felt a little confused, my head was muddled, and I couldn't help asking three questions from my soul.
who I am? Where am I? What am I doing?
At this time, a female voice came from the side, and she said in surprise, "Master Feifan, you are finally awake. The master and his wife will be very happy to know."
Extraordinary young master? Who is it, me? What's going on?
I held my head with my hands and thought about it for a long time. I just remembered that I, as a humble social worker, worked an extra day at work and lay down in bed after returning home. I was so sleepy that I wanted to take a quick rest. Why did it happen like this when I opened my eyes? I quickly patted my face. It hurt a little, which meant that it was not a dream, but rather like time travel.
Em... But it feels like this time travel seems to be very casual. I was neither hit by a car, nor struck by lightning, nor did I click on some mysterious options on the computer. I was just tired from working overtime and went home to take a nap. Can this also time travel?
Damn it! ! ! Did he die from overexertion while sleeping? No, SIR, I haven’t heard of it. You can die from overwork while sleeping. This is too outrageous.
Just as I was thinking wildly, the female voice next to me continued, "Master Feifan, you have just woken up. Do you feel any discomfort in your body?"
Hearing this question, I answered subconsciously.
"Well, it's okay. I don't feel anything wrong. Maybe I just woke up and am still a little dizzy."
"I understand. Now Xiaofang is going to inform the master and his wife. They are working in the family market in the city. It may take some time. You can wait in the room for a while. There are snacks on the table. If Master Feifan feels hungry, you can eat some to satisfy your stomach."
After saying that, he hurriedly exited the room, leaving me here to continue to be confused.
Taking this opportunity, I sorted out the information I had obtained. First of all, my name is Fei Fei. Not to mention, this name sounds unusual and promising, but the surname is Fei. This is a very rare surname. Unfortunately, it is not a common surname after time travel, which makes it a bad start.
Also, I am a young master, which means my family must be pretty good. The one named Xiaofang just now must be the maid, right? He said that he had informed my parents, which means that my parents are still alive and have not joined the orphanage series.
em...I don't know if this is good or bad. We can draw experience from the online novels in the previous life. Generally, those who have no father or mother after time travel will have great achievements in the future. Let alone the fairy king who started out and got better, then they are the foundation of the great emperor. They can be promoted in one life and become invincible in the world.
Tsk, tsk, tsk, according to this calculation, my start is simply hard difficulty. Hey, it is really difficult to overcome. And as a person who has traveled through time, after all, he is so old and his mind has matured. It is difficult to have a family relationship with his new parents. How to deal with the relationship with his parents is also a problem. I don’t know if it will affect my Taoist heart in the future.
By the way, I don’t know whether this is a world of high martial arts or low martial arts. The question of Taoist heart seems not that important?
Not only that, now in my mindThere is absolutely no memory of this person called Fei Fei, and he has no clue. How to communicate with his parents later is also a big problem. It seems that he can only pretend to have amnesia.
Sure enough, when I read the novel, I thought it was cliché to have amnesia at the beginning after time travel, but now it seems that this is the only way. After all, both eyes are black. Otherwise, can you just say that I am a person from another world? Mighty reincarnation? He probably wouldn't survive more than 5 minutes.
There are no bad routines, only suitable routines.
Later, when the original parents of this body came, I just pretended to have amnesia without arousing any suspicion. This made me relax a little bit after I was very nervous at the beginning. I learned from them that this body was called Ye Feifan. (My original surname is Ye. I told you earlier. As soon as I heard this surname, I knew it was going to be something big. It is one of the four major families after time travel. Although I have parents, fortunately I did not break away from the routine and gradually returned to the familiar starting point.)
